name: No Fresh Start For Failing Cultures
text: A failing culture must not be able to restart under a new name. A replacement culture gets a new identity, linked to its predecessor only by a verified record of where it came from.
scope_conditions: The Register article reports a product launch. It is not an empirical test of these claims.
The position is Kaal's own argument in the essay Who Vouches for a Dish of Neurons?
The position proposes a design for a trust record. No such record for biological compute units has been built or tested.
The position is limited to accountability and trust records for rented biological compute units.
